content_metadata.description: A humorous and insightful account of a major casting change during the making of Back to the Future. Christopher Lloyd's engaging storytelling and the interviewer's prompting questions make for an entertaining and informative watch.

qAndA.question: What was Christopher Lloyd drinking during the interview?

qAndA.answer: He said he was called at home by the producer at 1 am.
qAndA.question: What specific time does Christopher Lloyd say he was called to the studio?

qAndA.answer: He mentions it was made in the parking lot of the set in the City of Industry.
qAndA.question: Where does Christopher Lloyd say the announcement was made?

qAndA.answer: He says they wanted someone with a 'comic flair.'
qAndA.question: What does Christopher Lloyd say the producers were looking for in the character of Marty McFly?

qAndA.answer: He was initially shocked and overwhelmed but eventually felt it worked out for the best.
qAndA.question: What was Christopher Lloyd's initial reaction when he learned he would have to reshoot scenes?

narrativeProgression.description: The interviewer asks about Christopher Lloyd's experience with the Back to the Future reshoot.
Lloyd describes getting a phone call from the producer asking him to come to the studio.
Lloyd learns that Eric Stoltz has been fired and Michael J. Fox is cast as Marty.
The interviewer asks Lloyd if he knew about the recasting before the announcement.
Lloyd describes the announcement being made on set and his reaction.
